baslik: How Water Destroyed a $1.4 Billion Stealth Bomber

sahneler.metin: This crash destroyed a 1.4 billion dollar stealth bomber.
It pitched up, stalled, and fell seconds after takeoff.
So what brought down a jet this advanced? Just water.
Humid air left moisture inside three of its air-data sensors.
The flight computer got false readings of speed and angle.
It believed the nose was pointing down and pitched it sharply up.
Crews now heat those sensors before calibrating them.

aciklama:
On February 23, 2008, a B-2 Spirit crashed on takeoff at Andersen Air Force Base, Guam. Moisture in air-data sensors fed its flight computers false readings.
